introText: Ghost Tequila’s presence is concentrated in select U.S. urban hotspots, with standout traction in New England/Massachusetts, Texas, Southern California, and Miami/Southeast Florida. International availability remains limited to niche pockets and online interest.
primaryMarkets: Massachusetts / New England (core market; brand origin)
emergingMarkets: Pacific Northwest (Portland/Seattle craft cocktail hubs; growing uptake)
Chicago (Midwest urban hub; limited but increasing availability)
closingText: Strongest resonance appears where cocktail culture and spicy flavors intersect, with clear upside across the broader Midwest and select international pockets. Focused distribution and partnerships could accelerate conversion in these emerging markets.
